// diagnostic

E0704

Foreign crate fetch/build failed (cargo detail indented)

What

Foreign crate fetch/build failed (cargo detail indented)

Why

The registered jet rule applies here. A `jet build` run reports this foreign-crate failure.

Fix

Inspect the cargo error, then fix the foreign crate and rerun the build.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0704: tests/ui/ffi_fetch_failed.stderr.

Error [E0704]: Couldn't fetch or build `not-a-real-crate-xyz@9.9.9`
 Why: Cargo could not resolve or build this foreign crate bridge
 Fix: Check the crate version, network, and Cargo diagnostic, then try again
